local_changes: mcl86_eu_core.sv: drive previously undriven system_signals[15:14,10] to zero

Generate ADD source masks and reserved jump-source usage from all control-ROM words; specialize only unobservable ADD inputs and unused jump-source hold paths. Factor jump conditions as parallel Boolean logic without changing their truth table.

Preserve only the full logic operand-1 selection as a combinational module and map it after generic synthesis to two native LUT levels; prioritize measured BIU-return and immediate sources on fast inputs. ADD muxes remain inferred independently.
Compute prefetch-empty by direct low-four-bit pointer equality, equivalent to a zero four-bit pointer difference for every pointer value; retain the occupancy subtraction for other queue flags.

Split the unchanged microcode into four byte-lane ROMs with independent system-edge next-PC address copies. Decode operand controls from the raw ROM output before independent system-edge logic/ADD registers; preserve the logical sequencer lead.
Factor the original microcode-PC next-value equations without changing jump, stall, reset or call-stack behavior; drive the CPU PC and local ROM address copies from the same next value.

Use alternating operand-read and execute/writeback phases at the unchanged100MHz fabric clock. Register ALU operands and dispatch byte; advance ROM/PC/control stages only on execute; consume each held BIU strobe once while retaining the full-rate BIU and completion capture.
Generate the reset-entry word from the unchanged image and reset ROM word/control outputs to it, so a one-cycle reset cannot execute a stale in-flight word.
Read the local-address microcode ROMs on the ordinary100MHz system edge between execute edges; preserve execute-word latency and remove the obsolete phase-shifted ROM clock interface and PLL output.
